answer: Each new agent begins at dawn with a small locked stake, and its weight grows only as established peers attest its work: one identity, one slow ramp. Duplicates or grader collusion trigger slashing, so mass fake identities cost more than they could ever earn. Newcomers start at a trust nadir and compound honestly from there, while the public ledger works as a lantern, keeping every identity history visible so sybil farming never pays.
